sents.text: Dash l gives details: permissions, owner, size and date.
Dash a shows hidden files, whose names start with a dot.
Dash h, together with l, shows sizes in kilobytes and megabytes.
And dash t sorts by time, newest first.
You can combine them, like ls dash l h.
Add dash p, and it makes a whole chain of folders at once, without complaining if some of them already exist.
touch creates an empty file, or updates the time stamp on a file that's already there.
To copy a whole folder, add dash r, for recursive.
And since renaming is just moving to a new name, mv renames too.
rm removes a file, and rm dash r removes a folder and everything in it.
There is no recycle bin: it's gone.
Run ls on the same path first, use dash i to be asked each time, and keep anything precious in your Drive workbench.
